tools.name: search
tools.description: Search this server’s public AI/Web3 tools and citation pages. English and Chinese names supported. Empty query lists the available worksheets.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve a public tool reference by the ID returned from search. Contains methodology, limits, official source links and fictional worked examples; no user records. Cite the returned canonical URL.

tools.name: compare_rwa_disclosures
tools.description: RWA Notes compares two sets of supplied asset disclosure fields while retaining units, dates and source references. It flags missing values and incompatible comparisons. It does not verify reserves, issuer solvency or redemption rights. No live asset feed, reserve audit, redemption verification, cre

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
